name: Shanghai Shen Lian Biomedical Corporation
summary: Shanghai Shen Lian Biomedical Corporation operates within China's animal health industry, specializing in the entire lifecycle of veterinary biological products, from initial research and development to manufacturing and sales. A primary focus for the company is the creation of advanced synthetic peptide vaccines, specifically engineered to combat foot-and-mouth disease. This enterprise was established in 2001 and is based in Shanghai, China.
